candidates.title: P1: Implement contract validators and mock adapter registration
candidates.objective: Create a local contract-only package with CapabilityManifest, Observation, ActionIntent, VerificationResult, EvidenceLedgerEntry validators plus CLI/Web/glasses/embedded/robot mock manifests.
acceptance_evidence: unit tests show invalid physical capability without readback/audit/gates fails
all mock manifests register without Core code branching
json/schema fixtures pass positive and negative cases
candidates.anti_drift_check: No Web/PWA/glasses/robot/platform imports in Core; no real hardware/external side effect; validators fail closed.
candidates.parallel_boundary: Can run independently from UI/hardware work; blocks Web Workbench implementation.
candidates.human_gate: required before code changes or taskpool write

candidates.title: P2: Implement EvidenceLedger reducer and replay harness fixtures
candidates.objective: Append-only ledger prototype with reducer-derived WorldState and replay command over fixture sessions.
acceptance_evidence: completion claim without evidence is rejected
adapter direct WorldState write fixture fails
candidates.anti_drift_check: WorldState is derived only from ledger/reducer; no chat transcript or UI state as source of truth.
candidates.parallel_boundary: Depends on P1 contract validators; independent from real adapters.
candidates.human_gate: required before code changes or taskpool write

candidates.title: P3: Specify Web Workbench as non-authoritative operator surface
candidates.objective: After P1/P2 pass, define Workbench views for TaskGraph, WorldState, CapabilityRegistry, ActionIntent queue, EvidenceLedger, and gate decisions.
acceptance_evidence: Workbench spec shows no planner/safety core logic in UI
same session inspectable from CLI mock and Workbench
candidates.anti_drift_check: Web remains adapter/viewer/approval surface, not product boundary or source of truth.
candidates.parallel_boundary: Depends on P1/P2 artifacts; no hardware dependency.

candidates.title: P2: Implement Ego-NeuroLoop LoopCore contract helper and receipt tests
candidates.objective: Add a local-only deterministic LoopCore contract helper that emits ego_neuroloop_core_receipt_v0 from fixture ActionIntent/WorldState inputs, proving adaptive exit, deferred decode labels, and high-risk fail-closed boundaries.
acceptance_evidence: unit tests prove stable early exit when delta is low and confidence sufficient
unit tests prove high-risk intents exit via risk_gate/human_gate with side-effect flags false
unit tests prove missing evidence, contradiction, and budget exhaustion negative cases
AST/import guard proves core helper has no adapter/platform imports
existing HEWOS unittest suite remains green
candidates.anti_drift_check: Contract/mock only; no real ML quality claim, no hardware/external dispatch/deploy/auth/destructive action, no durable memory write from NeuroState.
candidates.parallel_boundary: Depends on HEWOS contract/replay core; can be implemented as local reversible tests and helper only.
candidates.human_gate: not required for local reversible contract helper; required for taskpool ingestion, runtime model use, device integration, or external side effects
